title: Nonnegativity of the row marginal
statement: Let $\sigma$ be a joint distribution on $\mathrm{Fin}\,M \times \mathrm{Fin}\,N$, so $\sigma_{ij} \ge 0$ for all $i,j$ and $\sum_{i,j} \sigma_{ij} = 1$. Then for every row action $i$ the row marginal $\sigma^{\mathrm{row}}_i = \sum_{j} \sigma_{ij}$ satisfies $\sigma^{\mathrm{row}}_i \ge 0$.
hypotheses_covered: σ is a joint distribution (entries nonnegative, sum to 1)
i is a row action in Fin M
replaced:
For any joint distribution $\sigma$ and row action $i$,
$\sigma^{\mathrm{row}}_i \ge 0$.
